name: Progression, then Change of Provider on the Progression Episode
description: Provider A creates ZSC00001, completes it, and progresses the learner onto ZSC00002 via PUT (in the same payload as the completion). Provider A then withdraws ZSC00002. Provider B — who has no prior episode for this learner — POSTs the same learner onto ZSC00002. Expected: a second episode is added to ZSC00002's existing Learning (Change of Provider), not a separate third Learning. Exercises the untested 'Progression, then CoP on the new episode' interaction documented in upcoming/subsequent-course-same-provider.md; depends on CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler's GetByLearnerKey lookup being CourseCode-scoped (FLP-1858).

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Completes ZSC00001 and Progresses onto ZSC00002 in a Single PUT
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Short Course for ZSC00002 (Change of Provider)

assertions.name: ZSC00001: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (Provider A only)
ZSC00002: 2 ShortCourseEpisode rows in Learning DB (Provider A withdrawn + Provider B)
ZSC00002's 2 episodes belong to a single Learning (CoP, not a third Learning)
3 ShortCourseEpisode rows total in Learning DB for this learner
ZSC00001: 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB
ZSC00002: 2 ShortCourseEpisode rows in Earnings DB
ZSC00002's 2 episodes share a single LearningKey in Earnings DB
3 ShortCourseEpisode rows total in Earnings DB
